faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the TNRD Perambalur Record Clerk recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application for the TNRD Perambalur Record Clerk positions is 30th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the department before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the minimum educational qualification required for the Record Clerk post?
faq.answer: The minimum educational qualification required for the Record Clerk position is a 10th Pass. Candidates who have successfully completed their 10th standard are eligible to apply.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for applying to the Record Clerk post?
faq.answer: The age limit for applying to the Record Clerk post is between 18 years and 37 years. Age relaxations are applicable for certain categories as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Record Clerk position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Record Clerk post will receive a salary ranging from Rs. 15900 to Rs. 58500 per month, as per the pay scale mentioned in the official notification.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the TNRD Perambalur Record Clerk jobs?
faq.answer: The application process for TNRD Perambalur Record Clerk jobs is offline. You need to download the application form from the official website, fill it out, and send it along with necessary documents to the specified address.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for the TNRD Perambalur Record Clerk recruitment?
faq.answer: The application fee for the TNRD Perambalur Record Clerk recruitment is Rs. 50/- for all categories, including General/OBC and SC/ST candidates.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Record Clerk post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Record Clerk post typically involves Document Verification and an Interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their performance in these stages.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official notification for TNRD Perambalur Record Clerk recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification for TNRD Perambalur Record Clerk recruitment can be found on the official website of the Rural Development and Panchayat Raj Department Perambalur, and a direct link is provided in the Important Links section.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any age relaxation for specific categories?
faq.answer: Yes, age relaxation is provided for Persons with Disabilities (+10 years) and Ex-Servicemen (up to 55 years) as mentioned in the official recruitment advertisement.

faq.question: Q10. What documents are required to be submitted with the application form?
faq.answer: Candidates are required to attach self-attested copies of necessary documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and educational certificates with the application form.
